# Font regression fixtures

`NotoSansHebrew.ttf` is the unmodified Google Fonts variable TrueType font, used only to check that ordinary PDF redraw refuses right-to-left mixed-script text even when the original embedded font covers it. It is not bundled with the application.

Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosanshebrew
Download: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/notosanshebrew/NotoSansHebrew%5Bwdth,wght%5D.ttf
License: SIL Open Font License, in `NotoSansHebrew-OFL.txt`.
